functions.already_reported: bool per stage; deliveries tracked separately for write and submit
functions.evaluate: runs new_formula_errors + uniformity_breaks + broken_check_cells; returns ok:false report or ok:true reason
functions.mark_reported: persists reported_<stage>=true as JSON state file
functions.record_report: appends {stage, report} to .librecalc_commit_report.json beside the workbook

inputs.backend: UnoCalcBackend (UNO/Calc): inspect_workbook used ranges + read_ranges include_errors=True
inputs.commit_checks: product domain module (pure functions over cell maps)

commit_gate_module.note: Three checks wired: new_formula_errors + uniformity_breaks + broken_check_cells. unrequested_write, referential_integrity, unextended_continuation, region_width_extension are NOT wired (measured and rejected, or scoped elsewhere).

outputs_report_schema.note: facts-not-suggestions text; next submit is final

sampling_capping.representatives_are_a_sample: bool; counts always complete, only addresses sampled

historical_fixes_present.evidence: benchmark/sweagent/librecalc/lib/commit_gate.py: _summarise (complete counts + per-sheet + sampled addresses), record_report (.librecalc_commit_report.json), already_reported/mark_reported per-stage; benchmark/sweagent/librecalc/lib/calc_tool.py: _with_write_report (write-stage) + commit_report command (submit-stage); tests/test_commit_gate.py pins all of it

error_origins_counted: evaluated error value (backend errors matrix / cached value carrying an error token)
formula text already carrying a broken reference token (e.g. =#REF!)
normalization_rules: both workbooks read through the SAME engine (UNO), so Excel-authored vs saved representation differences cannot register as changes
error_kind(value/formula): SPREADSHEET_ERROR_TOKEN regex on the value first, else spreadsheet_error_kind on the formula text
no DataTable/excel-artifact normalization needed live (both sides UNO); the offline replay path normalizes DataTableFormula/ArrayFormula via a sentinel and is NOT the live path
comparison is per-cell error presence, not value equality: a recalculated formula whose value moved but stayed non-error is not a finding
live_error_delta_computation.outputs: list[CommitFinding(check='new_formula_error', sheet, address, detail='output has {KIND} here; the input did not')]
live_error_delta_computation.rule: a cell is a finding iff the OUTPUT shows a spreadsheet error there and the INPUT shows none at the same (sheet, address)

product_rc_status.detail: No reference to commit gate/checks in src/librecalc_agent/*.py or src/librecalc_mcp/server.py. The live mechanism (gate + wiring) exists only in the old structured harness bundle (benchmark/sweagent/librecalc/) plus the frozen pure domain logic (src/librecalc_mcp/domain/commit_checks.py). The frozen architecture (FINAL_ARCHITECTURE_FREEZE.md) retains the ordinary coding-agent core and does NOT include formula-error feedback; MECHANISM_DISCOVERY is CLOSED. This probe modified nothing.
product_rc_status.frozen_architecture: ordinary coding-agent core + conditional hidden A+A1/capture/freshness; no feedback surface

recognition_error_kinds.note: Any token matching SPREADSHEET_ERROR_TOKEN counts, including LibreOffice-native Err:NNN codes surfaced via UNO cell.Error/cell.String (live path surfaces Err:522/Err:509/Err:502; see live_offline_parity.json).

recalc_path_uno.detail: Reads open the document and read used ranges as-is (recalc-on-load behavior is the container/user LO default). Writes call doc.calculateAll() before saving, so live-gate reads of UNO-written outputs always see freshly calculated values. For archived OPENPYXL-written outputs (stale/empty caches), live-equivalent replay MUST recalculate-then-save-then-read; see live_offline_parity.json modes.
recalc_path_uno.error_channel: _read_target queries cell.Error per formula cell and records cell.String (the displayed error token, e.g. #VALUE!, Err:522); constants/blanks never queried

functions._DocumentContext: open via loadComponentFromURL, close (no save) on read path
functions._save_document: store()/storeToURL with Calc MS Excel 2007 XML filter

recalc_path_uno.pyuno: system /usr/lib/python3/dist-packages/uno.py; listener: soffice --headless --accept socket; health ok:true verified this session

report_summarisation.rule: group by check; per-sheet counts complete; representatives = first <=8 per sheet (sorted), <=80 overall; representatives_are_a_sample flag

submit_stage.blocking: blocks ONCE: first submit returns the report (exit 1, no <<SWE_AGENT_SUBMISSION>>); next submit always succeeds (already_reported('submit'))
submit_stage.emit_condition: gate enabled AND not already reported submit AND evaluate finds >=1 finding; gate errors fail open (ok:true) and never block
submit_stage.path: calc_tool.py commit_report command (283-297), invoked by bin/submit wrapper; wrapper prints <<SWE_AGENT_SUBMISSION>> only when commit_report exits 0

write_stage.emit_condition: gate enabled AND not already reported write AND first saving write whose evaluate finds >=1 finding; report exceptions swallowed (write result returned unchanged); zero-finding writes pass through silently
write_stage.paths: calc_tool.py _with_write_report (229-250), attached to write, fill-formulas, and program commands (NOT upsert-chart); record via mark_reported('write') + record_report(report,'write')

calc_compare_semantic_diff.note: Agent-invoked self-comparison (what did I change?), NOT the world-initiated gate. Its formula_errors added/removed/changed section answers questions the agent asked, from observations the agent requested; it cannot surface edits the agent did not know to make. Sampling: downstream-values shape with bounded representatives (the shape _summarise copies).
